blockbuilder-explorer.visual_critic_note: Deliberate dark theme with coherent grid layout and clear panel hierarchy, but the color usage scatter chart is dense and visually noisy — dots are too small to distinguish, undermining the panel that should be the most visually interesting.
blockbuilder-explorer.encoding_integrity_note: Zero baseline on histogram, scaleSqrt for circle radii in both network and color views, data-driven utcMonth binning, and fixed HCL domains [0,360]/[0,100] that are semantically correct; minor: no key functions on data joins, but bins are order-stable so no practical corruption risk.
blockbuilder-explorer.stress_test_note: Dirty-flag + RAF pattern correctly coalesces all brush and click updates; pointer events unify mouse/touch; no transitions eliminate mid-flight conflicts; only minor concern is O(n) BitFilter.set() computed synchronously on every brush mousemove before the deferred render.
blockbuilder-explorer.cognitive_load_note: Four-view crossfilter layout is well within working memory limits and the network hub structure is legible at 60 nodes, but the color-usage panel is a near-opaque wall of rainbow dots that yields no extractable pattern at a glance — interaction is required to make it useful, and that dependency is not signaled to the viewer.
